Conclusion: The test `pandas.tests.indexes.test_numeric.TestFloat64Index.test_lookups_datetimelike_values()` is checking whether the `__getitem__` method of `pandas.core.indexing._ScalarAccessIndexer` correctly handles non-integer indexers. Therefore, the ValueError "At based indexing on an non-integer index can only have non-integer indexers" is raised because 4 is not a valid tuple.
